subject: Logic
title: The Omnipotence Paradox
description: A fast breakdown of The Omnipotence Paradox for builders.

hook.text: Can an all-powerful being create a stone so heavy even they can't lift it?

buildup.text: If yes, there's something they can't do (lift it). If no, there's something they can't do (create it).

discovery.text: Either way, omnipotence seems to contain its own limitation—a contradiction baked into the concept.

twist.text: Some philosophers argue that logical impossibilities aren't real limitations—even omnipotence needn't do the impossible.

climax.text: The paradox forces us to define what "all-powerful" actually means. Many definitions quietly collapse.

quiz.question: What does the omnipotence paradox challenge?
